iWelcome

Make yourself at home

Welcome to Sonoran Country Club in Glendale, Arizona. Everything you need for a relaxed stay — arrival to checkout — is gathered here. Feel free to share this guide with your travel companions.

Don’t forget to bring

Personal toiletries, your camera, and phone chargers or adaptors. Basic toiletries and hair dryers are supplied, and the nightstands have charging stations.

Getting here

The property address and directions are provided with your reservation details.

iiArrival

Settling in

Check-in time

Check-in is after 4:00 PM, Arizona time.

Self check-in

Check-in is self-service. Your arrival details are sent to you securely before your stay — please confirm you’ve received them before you travel.

Early check-in

Early check-in may be available for a fee but is not guaranteed. Please request it in advance.

Wi-Fi

Free Wi-Fi is available; connection details are provided separately with your arrival information. Guests are responsible for safe and legal use. If service drops, please contact your host.

iiiThe house

Inside

Thermostat & climate

The thermostat is in the dining room, behind the coffee bar. Please keep windows and exterior doors closed so heating and cooling run efficiently. Your host can also adjust the temperature remotely.

Dishwasher

Scan the QR code on the dishwasher for settings and troubleshooting.

Washer & dryer

Located off the garage entrance, with instructions posted on each machine. If troubleshooting doesn’t help, contact your host.

TVs & streaming

Remotes are labeled and kept near the light switches. Please log out of any personal streaming accounts before checkout.

Games & indoor play

The home includes games, an indoor putting green, and a mini pickleball / ping-pong setup.

ivOutdoors

Under the desert sky

Grill

Please leave the grill clean to avoid additional cleaning fees. Replacement propane can be requested from your host.

Outdoor dining & bar

Use the plastic, non-breakable tableware outdoors. At the outdoor bar: plastic cups and cans only — no glass. Please keep cushions on their designated chairs.

Fire pit

The fire pit runs on propane. Use caution and keep a safe distance.

Hot tub

A six-person hot tub is available.

Operating guidance pending host confirmation

Sport court

The multi-sport court supports pickleball, basketball, and volleyball. Please return equipment to storage after use.

Turf & short course

The turf area is for suitable grass activities. The four-hole short course is for golf and putting only — please return equipment to the white locker.

Patio sound system

The patio speakers pair via Bluetooth. Please keep the volume considerate of neighbors.

vHouse rules

A few courtesies

  • Quiet hours10:00 PM – 7:00 AM
  • Smoke-freeNo smoking or vaping inside the home or in the surrounding outdoor areas.
  • Pet-freeThis is a pet-free home.
  • BreakagesPlease report anything broken promptly. Higher-cost replacements are handled under your rental agreement.
viSafety

If you need help

Emergency: call 911

For ambulance, police, or fire. Give the property address from your reservation details.

Fire

Leave the home quickly, make sure everyone is accounted for, and do not go back inside until a fire officer says it is safe.

First aid & fire extinguisher

A first-aid kit and fire extinguisher are kept under the kitchen sink.

Non-emergency help

For non-urgent issues, contact your host through your reservation messages.

viiNearby golf

Tee it up nearby

Public-access courses in the West Valley. Book directly with each course.

Grand Canyon University Golf Course

Phoenix · 18-hole municipal

City-owned former Maryvale Golf Course, operated by GCU. A parkland layout with mature trees and shade; welcomes golfers of all levels.

Book a tee time ›

Bellair Golf Park

Glendale · 18-hole short course

A renovated par-59 executive course that plays in about 2–3 hours, plus a Toptracer range — easy for mixed-ability groups.

Course & tee times ›

Desert Mirage at Golf Ranch

Glendale · 9-hole executive

A relaxed 9-hole executive course alongside a Trackman driving range. Good for a quick round or short-game practice.

Course & tee times ›

The 500 Club

Glendale · public tee times

A northwest Valley course with online tee-time booking. Also home to The Futures Course.

Visit course site ›

Coyote Lakes Golf Club

Surprise · 18 holes

Open for public tee times; known locally as a fun, challenging West Valley course.

Visit course site ›

Rates, hours and availability are set by each course; check their site before you go. Sonoran Country Club is not affiliated with these courses.

ixDeparture

Until next time

Checkout is by 10:00 AM, Arizona time. Late checkout must be requested in advance and depends on same-day arrivals and cleaning availability.

Before you go

Optional — not required, but appreciated.

  • Leave beds unmade
  • Put used towels in the shower
  • Gather and rinse dishes
  • Empty the trash
  • Lock doors and windows
  • Turn off lights
  • Turn off the propane

Thank you for staying with us — we’d love to hear about your stay.
